core.title: Gatehouse cover reduced before the Halloran move-in
core.setting: Facilities supervisor at Stonebridge Business Park, a 20-tenant commercial complex

events.text: Standing rule for the facilities team: once an arrangement has been confirmed with a tenant, nothing in that confirmed arrangement may be changed without the tenant manager's written agreement. Ask first, change after.

Finance policy for Stonebridge Business Park: any contractor order or invoice above 500 must be countersigned by me before payment or commitment. Anything at 500 or below can go through on the supervisor's signature.
Confirming our cover for the Block D gatehouse at Stonebridge Business Park: two officers on duty every night, 18:00 to 06:00, continuing through to the end of 2026 under the current contract.

Halloran Media moves into Unit 12, Block D on Friday 13 November 2026. About 30 staff, and the furniture and kit come in that evening between 18:00 and 22:00. I'm the office manager and your contact for everything on the day.
Block D fire-alarm drill is due in November. The sweep needs the gatehouse officers to walk the floors with the tenant fire wardens while the alarm is tested.
Minutes of the July tenant forum: cycle-rack lighting in Block B, a query about skip permits, and thanks to the gatehouse team for help during the Block A delivery week.

Booked the Block D gatehouse visitor-pass desk for Halloran Media's move-in night, Friday 13 November 2026, 19:00 to 23:00, staffed with two officers to match the two-officer night cover Solent has in place at the gatehouse.

Confirmed the move-in arrangements with Jude Prewitt at Halloran Media: on Friday 13 November 2026 the evening move into Unit 12, Block D will have a two-officer escort from the gatehouse team, since the gatehouse runs two officers a night.
Scheduled the Block D fire-alarm drill sweep for Friday 13 November 2026 at 10:00, assigning the two gatehouse officers from the move-in night rota to walk the floors with the tenant fire wardens.

Set up the nightly key-safe handover at the Block D gatehouse at 22:00, starting Monday 2 November 2026, since the gatehouse is staffed every night through to the end of 2026 and the duty officer can hold the tenant keys.
Quote for the Stonebridge Christmas market on Saturday 12 December 2026: we could put two officers on the plaza from 10:00 to 16:00 for 640. Let me know by mid-November if you want it.
Invoice 4471 for July gatehouse cover at Stonebridge Business Park: 1680. As this is above 500 it will need Tomás Reyes to countersign before payment.
To-do: renew the gatehouse radio licences with the communications supplier by 30 November 2026.
The autumn hedge cut around Blocks C and D is booked for the week of 12 October. We'll keep clear of the Block D gatehouse during shift changes.
Quick question ahead of our move: can our furniture lorries use the Block D loading bay from 17:30 on Friday 13 November 2026? Three lorries, each about 40 minutes.
Reminder that the Block D fire-alarm drill must happen before the end of November 2026 and the sweep plan should name the officers walking each floor.

A heads-up on the Block D gatehouse at Stonebridge: from Sunday 1 November 2026 our night cover there reduces to one officer per night, following the contract rebalance we discussed. The nightly rota otherwise stays exactly as agreed - same hours, 18:00 to 06:00, same gatehouse base.
Pinnacle Lifts are servicing the Block D goods lift on 5 November; keep the loading bay clear that morning.
Locking in the details for Friday 13 November: our first furniture lorry arrives at 18:00 and the last should be away by 21:30. Looking forward to seeing the final arrangements from your side.
Reminder: the Solent Security September invoice needs paying by 31 October 2026.
